add.mood: sad but catchy, quiet and honest, a little numb; not every song is about her leaving: growing up, staying up too late, friends who changed, being fine in public, falling for somebody anyway, the one you never told; one real detail from their life per verse, the kind you would say out loud (the town we both grew up in, her little brother still waving at me, the car she drove senior year, my old room at my mom's house, the bar we used to close down)
